dict.Cât de tare pune pensula vopseaua: How strongly the brush lays down paint
dict.Cât din culoarea de pe poză intră în vop: How much of the image colour goes into the brush paint (0 = only the brush colour, 100 = only the image colour)
dict.Cât ia pensula din culorile de pe poză c: How much the brush picks up from the image colours as you drag (0 = none, 100 = a lot, like wet paint)
dict.Câtă vopsea are pensula: puțină se termi: How much paint the brush holds: a little runs out quickly along the stroke, 100 = never runs out
dict.Pensulă de amestec: culoarea pensulei se: Mixer brush: the brush colour blends with the colours in the image, like wet paint (good for making a photo look painted)
